visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A blue Stitch character bluetooth speaker sits on a light wooden table. A hand reaches in and presses the top of its head, causing the wide mouth to pop open and shut in a rhythmic loop. (2) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black graphic t-shirt, holds a large yellow and blue product box labeled 'Aloha' and 'Stitch Bluetooth Speaker' in front of a white sofa. (3) She sets the box down on the table and begins pulling out the internal cardboard inserts and white documentation. (4) She slides out a transparent plastic tray containing the blue speaker and a power cable, then removes the protective plastic film from the figure. (5) The woman presses the top of the Stitch speaker's head several times to demonstrate the mechanical mouth-opening mechanism. (6) She turns the speaker around to reveal a small blue tail on its backside, demonstrating how it rotates to adjust volume. (7) She plays music through the speaker; the mouth opens and closes in sync with the beat while she smiles and looks at the camera. (8) A series of close-up cuts show the mouth popping open and closed rapidly. (9) The woman holds the speaker and gestures toward it while speaking directly to the lens.
